name: Slack BSAR
description: Creates a Slack channel for every SAR CoreEvent placed on a configured CoreEvent Board.

permissions.description: Reads the current links of a CoreEvent so the Slack channel link is appended instead of replacing them
Adds the URL of the created Slack channel to the links of the CoreEvent

types.description: Creates a Slack channel when a SAR CoreEvent is first placed on the configured Board, unarchiving it if it already exists
Unarchives the Slack channel of a SAR CoreEvent when it is moved on the configured Board
